title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-10-29
ranking_explanation: Repositories were sorted in descending order by the “stars today” count shown on GitHub Trending (daily). Obvious list/course-style and jailbreak-list noise was excluded; 12 remaining repositories are reported. Total stars and current default-branch SHAs were corroborated via GitHub REST.
global_caveat: Trending gains are a point-in-time daily page signal and can change; current total-star counts and commits were fetched at 2026-10-29 01:41 UTC. Two GitHub Search API checks were rate-limited, but REST metadata and commit checks succeeded for all entries. No prior-window evidence was collected, so no shift comparison is claimed.

sections.content: Agentic development is the clearest cluster today, especially tools that make design quality and repeatable coding workflows explicit. DeepTutor leads the daily star-gain list, while several design-agent projects occupy the next highest positions.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
Design skills and quality gates for coding agents: Three of the top five by daily star gain—AI Design Skills, Hallmark, and Impeccable—focus on steering coding agents toward more deliberate interfaces and adding review or lint gates. Supporting repositories: 02-elayadesign-ai-design-skills, 03-nutlope-hallmark, 05-pbakaus-impeccable.
Agent workflows are becoming products, not just prompts: Superpowers, ThinkRail, OpenBot, Cindy, and Expo Skills span reusable methods, IDE workspaces, persistent desktop teammates, general-purpose agents, and framework-specific skills. Supporting repositories: 06-obra-superpowers, 07-jetbrains-thinkrail, 08-nightly-labs-openbot, 09-makecindy-cindy, 12-expo-skills.
AI-assisted learning: DeepTutor is the largest daily gainer, bringing personalized tutoring and a learning workspace into the AI application mix. Supporting repositories: 01-hkuds-deeptutor.
Cloud-drive utility tooling: LinkSwift is a sizeable outlier: its stated purpose is direct-link retrieval for eight Chinese cloud-drive services, not agent development. Supporting repositories: 04-hmjz100-linkswift.
Wi-Fi sensing and spatial inference: RuView represents a distinct signal-processing use case, claiming spatial, presence, and vital-sign inference from commodity Wi-Fi rather than video. Supporting repositories: 10-ruvnet-ruview.
Unified team workspaces: Macro points toward bundling communications and work management with shared AI memory in one workspace. Supporting repositories: 11-macro-inc-macro.
Languages in the listed repositories: TypeScript 3, Rust 3, Shell 2, and one each of Python, CSS, and JavaScript; one repository has no primary language listed.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s GitHub attention favors applied AI tooling over a single model or framework: coding agents are being wrapped in IDEs, reusable procedures, and design review systems. The list is not exclusively agent-centric, however—DeepTutor, LinkSwift, RuView, and Macro show continued interest in education, regional utility software, sensing, and integrated workspaces.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository and default-branch commit endpoints for all 12 listed repositories; GitHub Search API exact-name results for 10 of 12 (the remaining two Search API queries were rate-limited; REST metadata and commit checks succeeded). README enrichment: current READMEs for DeepTutor, AI Design Skills, Hallmark, Impeccable, Superpowers, ThinkRail, and OpenBot. Method note: star gains are the values shown on the matching daily Trending page; total stars and default-branch commits were checked through GitHub REST and may change after this snapshot. Obvious list/course and jailbreak-list noise was excluded.
